test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If Tan 15° = 2 - sqrt3, then the value of Tan 15° Cot 75° + Tan 75° Cot 15° is:
solution:
**Given:**

Tan 15° = 2 - √3

**Formula Used:**

Tan (90° - θ) = Cot θ

Cot (90° - θ) = Tan θ

Tan θ = 1/Cot θ

(a - b)² + (a + b)² = 2(a² + b²)

(a - b)(a + b) = a² - b²

**Calculation:**

Cot 15° = 1/tan15° 

⇒ 1/2 - √3 × (2 + √3)/(2 + √3)

⇒ (2 + √3)/(4 - 3) = 2 + √3

Tan 15° Cot 75° + Tan 75° Cot 15°

⇒ Tan 15° Cot (90° - 15°) + Tan (90° - 15°) Cot 15°

⇒ Tan 15° Tan 15° + Cot 15° Cot 15°

⇒ Tan² 15° + Cot² 15°

⇒ (2 - √3)² + (2 + √3)²

⇒ 2(2² + √3²)

⇒ 2(7) = 14

**∴ The value of Tan 15° Cot 75° + Tan 75° Cot 15° is 14.**
